entries.content:
**Findings**

Release 0.8.5 rejected normal agent-created changes because sequence integration required a clean child checkout. This caused the sequence to fail before squashing the result.

The issue was already fixed in commit `0676f117a` for version 0.8.6. Integration now stages and commits child changes before continuing in [sequence_worktree_execution.js](C:/Users/janbo/Documents/dev/md2/desktop/src/actions/schedule/sequence_worktree_execution.js:157).

**Proposed solution**

No further code change is needed. Keep the existing automatic step commit and close B_344 as fixed. Its regression test passes: 29/29 tests, including the dirty-child integration case in [sequence_worktree_execution.test.mjs](C:/Users/janbo/Documents/dev/md2/desktop/src/actions/schedule/sequence_worktree_execution.test.mjs:161).
